_doc: Main experiment model registry (GUIDE.md section 1). One entry per scored model; encode.py reads only this file, so a rerun with the same file and the same eval-set revision reproduces the run. env = venv key in run.sh. Revisions pinned 2026-10-09.

bm25.label: BM25
bm25.library: bm25s 0.2.14, method lucene, float64, scores x (k1 + 1)

qwen3_emb_0.6b.label: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B
qwen3_emb_0.6b.note: query prompt 'Query:' only (no Qwen default instruction), identical to our trained checkpoints (user 2026-10-09)

qwen3_emb_4b.label: Qwen3-Embedding-4B
qwen3_emb_4b.note: query prompt 'Query:' only (no Qwen default instruction), identical to our trained checkpoints (user 2026-10-09)

inf_retriever_v1_pro.label: inf-retriever-v1-pro
inf_retriever_v1_pro.pooling: last token (model card last_token_pool), then L2 normalize
inf_retriever_v1_pro.query_prompt:
Instruct: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
Query:
inf_retriever_v1_pro.note: query prompt = the model's saved 'query' prompt (config_sentence_transformers.json) and the model card's task, user 2026-10-11: use the official prompt; no document prompt. Remote code (bidirectional Qwen2) needs transformers 4.51.0 (model card) -> venv infret
inf_retriever_v1_pro.encoder: ../bright-top3-ablation/encode.py (main/encode.py has no hf_lasttoken kind); added 2026-10-11 (user): BRIGHT top2 model in the Main table

lateon.label: LateOn (0.1B)
lateon.note: 2026-10-11 user: max length 512 to match the other models (query 512 / doc 512; was query 64 / doc 300). do_query_expansion is false in the pinned config, so query 512 gives the same query vectors as 64 (checked); only doc 300 -> 512 changes scores
